name: tag_benchmark_tagged
description: A dataset of tagged math problems used to evaluate tagging and retrieval components in math-focused QA/RAG systems. It measures how well models can assign metadata tags or classifications to math questions to support retrieval and downstream solving. Useful for assessing label quality and tag-driven retrieval performance.
reputation: A niche dataset mainly used within the RAG4Math project and related research on math retrieval and tagging; limited widespread adoption.
